hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has an entry Arakwal [rkw] for an extinct Australian language.  Although Arakwal may be an (old or recent) ethnic group,
linguistically it is one of many Bandjalang [bdy] varieties
(**hh:h:Oates:Australia:1975**:212,
**hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**:354) and should not have a separate entry in a linguistic catalogue. See also: Middle Clarence [bdy].
